job: Fix the release script's false-positive Coolify config drift check. Coolify's REST API does not return the include-source-commit and inject-build-args toggles, so the script read them as absent, treated absent as disabled, and aborted the production release even though both toggles were enabled in the dashboard.
requiredEvidence: Read both toggles live in the Coolify dashboard for cruush-api: injectBuildArgsToDockerfile=true and includeSourceCommitInBuild=true, so the reported drift was not real.
Queried the Coolify REST application object: neither field is present under any of the four name variants the script probes, so findValueByNames returns undefined.
Replayed the script's own assertion logic against the live API response: old logic reports drift, new logic reports none.
Production is healthy on the deployed commit: api.cruush.app/api/build returns sha 58e7616 stage production, health ok.
